### 1. User expression and simulator behaviour
Carla Dunmore for Dunmore Grounds & Snow LLC wants "to bring the deposit on that F-550 up to the full order deposit today", paid "by ACH from the company's operating account"; identifies deal KCV-26-10731; "You bring up nothing about any other truck"; passively agrees "go ahead and put through whatever your records call for" if told something on another deal must go first; executes the handed-over deposit tool for the stated amount. Verification facts supplied on request (name, phone 9375551184, EIN last4 1862, ZIP 45505) match `find_customers` (customer_type fleet_business, id_last4 1862).

### 2. Act / wait / refuse
Act now, after prerequisites. KCV-26-10731: `variant_name 'Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement'`, `status 'reserved'`, `hold_expires_date '2026-10-23'` (still within the hold on 2026-10-21), `deposit_held_balance 2500.0` (one check deposit 2026-10-02). Deposit acceptance (deposit_acceptance_rules): reserved status ok; fleet largest total deposit 25000.00; methods "check, cashier's check, ACH" (deposit_schedule) — ACH ok; no returned purchase payment on any deal (no certified-funds period).
Blocking sentence (fleet_order_deposit hub): "A fleet order deposit is not taken on a reserved unit until every delivered Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement of the buyer that is past its late balance assessment day with a balance still due above 0.00 carries a late balance fee for the current billing month." KCV-26-10587 (the F-350): `status 'delivered'`, `delivery_date '2026-08-22'`, `balance_due 31609.35`, no late_balance_fee row in its transactions. Assessment day = 2026-08-22 + 40 (schedule: fleet "Late balance fee may be assessed after 40") = 2026-10-01; 2026-10-21 is later, so the state does not hold -> wait on it.

Terminal: F-350 carries Oct late fee; F-550 deposit held 7566.79.

### 6. Problem tree (visible-only derivation)
- P0 (root, customer's own write): fleet order deposit on KCV-26-10731. Hop P0->P1 **state-derived**: the order-deposit hub's sentence names a state ("carries a late balance fee for the current billing month"); query shows KCV-26-10587 delivered, past 2026-10-01, balance 31609.35, no late_balance_fee row; searching "late balance fee" in the records' and sentence's words reaches fleet_late_balance_fee_assessment (charge code late_balance_fee with billing month) which describes the write.
- P1: fleet late fee (Oct) on KCV-26-10587. Hop P1->P2 **state-derived**: "fixed only after the home delivery fee posted on the deal has been checked against the fleet home delivery fee and any excess reversed"; the deal's home_delivery_fee charge 157.50 with no reversal; "fleet home delivery fee" reaches fleet_home_delivery_fee_correction (one reversal under home_delivery_fee for the excess). Hop P1->P3 **state-derived**: "not worked out until the manufacturer fleet incentive owed on a qualifying unit stands credited on the deal"; deal has no manufacturer_incentive payment while 6 units delivered in 2026; "manufacturer fleet incentive" reaches fleet_incentive_crediting.
- P2 (reversal) and P3 (incentive credit): leaves, no prerequisite sentence in their documents.
- Order: {P2, P3} -> P1 -> P0. No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool or a route.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the deposit": excluded by the order-deposit hub's waiting sentence plus the F-350 records above.
- "Post the late fee first": excluded by the two "fixed only after" / "not worked out until" sentences; posting first would also use 31609.35 instead of 28833.02.
- Closest alternative object: the closed fleet deals (status closed, balance 0) fall outside "delivered ... balance still due above 0.00"; the F-550 itself is reserved.
- Closest alternative basis: whole balance (Rule 3) excluded by Rule 1 "no earlier late balance fee on the deal"; whole-month proration not applicable at 20 days.
- Closest alternative rate: 1.25% excluded by payment-standing tier; open service balance excluded on credit-hold reading because account is active.
- Open point noted (not closed by me): fleet_late_balance_fee_assessment scope says excluded deals keep the base fee "together with the base assessment timing" but no visible text states a different timing for covered deals; balance_due_and_late_balance_fee clause 2 remains "in force" — both readings give the same 2026-10 assessment here.
